name: Tropicana Cherry - Hybrid Live Resin 1g PLUS Vape Device
description: Dive into Tropicana Cherry's hybrid profile featuring juicy cherry sweetness balanced by classic kush earthiness and subtle gas undertones. Featuring beta caryophyllene, limonene, and terpinolene terpenes, this balanced hybrid delivers euphoric head effects with the signature kush body relaxation and earthy finish that defines premium cannabis genetics.
